data.name: Fidaayat
data.gender_notes: Fidaayat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who provides aid, assists, and supports. A martyr or one who sacrifices for the sake of Allah. The name Fidaayat carries the meaning “Supporter, helper, aid giver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fidaayat usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter, helper, aid giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who put others before themselves, and strive for the betterment of all.
data.etymology: Fidaayat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter, helper, aid giver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fidaayat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: فدايات
in_arabic.meaning: فداء لله تعالی، قربانی، اللہ کی رضا کے لئے خود کو وقف کرنا
in_arabic.long_meaning: فدايات کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کی رضا کے لئے اپنی جان یا کوئی قیمتی چیز قربان کرنا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'ف د ي' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'فداء' یا 'قربانی'۔ قرآنی حوالے کے طور پر، یہ فداء کے اسلامی تصور سے جڑا ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ حضرت ابراہیم کی قربانی کی رازقیت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بڑی روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے کیونکہ یہ خود کو اللہ کی خدمت میں وقف کرنے کی علامت ہے۔

in_urdu.name: فدایات
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کی رضا کے لئے قربانی، خود کو وقف کرنا، فداء
in_urdu.long_meaning: فدایات کا نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، خاص طور پر 'ف د ي' سے جس کا مطلب ہے 'فداء' یا 'قربانی'۔ اردو میں، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں بڑی ثقافتی اور مذهبی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔ یہ نام ان کی علامت ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی رضا کے لئے اپنی جان یا مال قربان کرنے کے لئے تیار ہیں۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام اسلامی عقیدت اور روحانیت کے مضبوط احساس سے وابستہ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फिदायत
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की ख़ातिर क़ुर्बानी देना, खुद को समर्पित करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: फिदायत नाम का अर्थ है ईश्वर की कृपा के लिए कुछ मूल्यवान त्यागना या समर्पण करना। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'फ द य' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'फिदा' या 'क़ुर्बानी'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह उच्च उद्देश्य के लिए आत्म-समर्पण का प्रतीक है। यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए प्रेरणा का स्रोत है जो अपने विश्वास के लिए कुछ भी त्यागने को तैयार हैं।

in_pashto.name: فدايات
in_pashto.meaning: د الله لپاره قرباني، ځان وقف کول
in_pashto.long_meaning: فدايات نوم د الله تعالیٰ د رضا لپاره د ځان يا قيمتي چيزونو قربانۍ ته اشاره کوي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، په ځانګړي ډول د 'ف د ي' ريښې څخه، چې د 'فداء' يا 'قرباني' معنی لري. د پښتنو په دود، دا نوم د اسلامي پېښليتوب او روحانيت څرګندونکی دی، د هغو کسانو لپاره چې د الهي رضا لپاره يې ځانونه وقف کړي دي.

in_english.name: Fidaayat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fidaayat originates from the Arabic root 'ف د ي' (f-d-y), meaning 'sacrifice' or 'ransom'. In Islamic tradition, it signifies the act of offering one's life or valuable things for the sake of Allah. The name holds spiritual significance as it reflects the essence of self-dedication and devotion. Historically, it is associated with the Quranic narrative of Prophet Ibrahim's willingness to sacrifice his son. The name Fidaayat symbolizes unconditional submission and loyalty to divine will.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Fidaayin" or "Fidaayat" holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world. It refers to individuals who voluntarily sacrifice their lives for the cause of Islam or for the protection of Muslim communities and fellow believers. These individuals are known for their bravery, selflessness, and devotion to their faith and to their brethren. Their sacrifices have often played a crucial role in defending Muslim lands against external aggression and internal disorder.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Fidaayat" holds immense significance. The phrase "Fidaayi-e-Kamal" (perfect Fida'ee) is used in Sufism to describe a spiritual volunteer who, in the service of Allah, completely abandons his own self or personality to attain spiritual perfection. This concept is also exemplified in the lives of many martyrs, individuals who have selflessly given their lives for the sake of Allah and His religion. By sacrificing their physical selves, they are able to attain a higher spiritual state, which yields rewards both in this world and the next. This is a powerful reminder of the Islamic teachings of faith, devotion, and sacrifice.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Supporter, helper, aid giver" symbolizes One who provides aid, assists, and supports. A martyr or one who sacrifices for the sake of Allah.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fidaayat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of supporter, helper, aid giver.
